verdict.rationale: Unity's own blog announces it is canceling the Runtime Fee (unity-docs-21), which removes the per-install charge that drew earlier complaints (unity-comm-1, unity-comm-2). The license is not permissive, though: it is a proprietary, revenue-tiered model. The free Personal plan is capped at under $100K in revenue and funds raised (unity-docs-15), and community reports describe unilateral license-tier upgrades, costly seats, and terms that can change at any time (unity-comm-5, unity-comm-6, unity-comm-15). missing for 10: a permissive or open license, first-party documentation of the post-cancellation pricing terms confirming no royalties at any revenue level, freedom from revenue-gated seat fees, and stable terms that cannot be changed unilaterally.
